scientific_role: Pre-graph-WB method-development revision of V3b graph execution. The frozen V3b provider reconstruction is unchanged; only M3 graph propagation is revised from a Top14 approximation to the complete 343-member weighted support.

eligibility.failure_policy: No recovery, repair, replacement, or recalibration of P2.

M1.provider_models: V3b common-N100 RMSE rank-1 candidate per provider

M2.provider_models: V3b common-N100 RMSE ranks 1..3 per provider
M2.point_prediction: equal-weight mean of all 27 joint-model curves

M3.provider_models: all seven frozen V3 candidates per provider
M3.provider_weights: unchanged V3 Jeffreys-smoothed Bernoulli-KL Gibbs weights with lambda=30

allocation.weights: full-support joint weights, already normalized to sum 1
allocation.integer_rule: initialize N_j=1 for all 343 ranks, then assign each remaining trajectory to the rank maximizing w_j^2/[N_j*(N_j+1)]
allocation.allocation_scope: one frozen allocation per eligible provider world, reused across all four graphs in that provider world

nested_diagnostics.Top1: rank 1 only, renormalized within rank 1, using its trajectory count from the full-support allocation
nested_diagnostics.Top3: ranks 1..3, renormalized within ranks 1..3, using their trajectory counts from the full-support allocation
nested_diagnostics.Top14: ranks 1..14, renormalized within ranks 1..14, using their trajectory counts from the full-support allocation

diagnostics: Top1/Top3/Top14 retained and omitted full-support mass
full-support plugin Monte-Carlo variance and standard error
full-support worst-case Monte-Carlo variance and standard-error bound
M3.immutability: No graph result may alter candidate identities, provider weights, joint weights, joint ranks, budget, allocation, or lambda.

M3.rank_seed_rule: rank r uses seed_base+(r-1)*seed_block_stride+k for k=0..N_r-1

queries.source: unchanged frozen Step-0 queries for each eligible physical cell

graph_prediction_must_not_read: Step-0 white-box values other than eligibility and frozen query definitions
final graph white-box ledgers or curves

execution_gate: A new full-support graph-adapter smoke and a new full-support pre-execution allocation freeze must pass before any scientific graph prediction.
